_comment: SYNTHETIC — hand-built, NOT recorded from a run. This is not validation of
seestar-mcp's contract and must never be cited as such.
fixtures/qa_tier2.json is a real recorded response, but from a run with no
subs (total 0, subs []), so it exercises the envelope and the nine medians
keys and nothing else. The Review & QA screen is made of subs[], so this
file exists to drive rendering until a real multi-sub payload can be
recorded (needs SEESTAR_ARCHIVE_DIR pointed at real .fit files).
Every field below is transcribed from verified source at seestar-mcp
- `name` is path.stem: NO .fit extension (qa_tier2.py:240). A join key
carrying the extension matches zero rows, silently.
- an unanalysable sub STAYS in subs[] with metrics.error set and the
other metrics null; star_count is 0 rather than null on that path.
- floats are rounded to 4 dp by _compact_metrics (_METRIC_DP).
- keep_list holds the names of subs whose verdict != REJECT.

Reason strings keep the MEASURED values (this file's own numbers) but do not quote policy cutoffs. Those live in seestar-mcp config.py; baking one into a fixture I authored would create a second copy that drifts silently, which is the same failure web/src/test/no-thresholds.test.ts guards against in source.
